claim: For every integer \(p\ge 2\), if \(R\) is uniform on the positive-definite \(p\times p\) correlation matrices and \(A=R-I_p\), then \(\mathbb E[\operatorname{tr}(A^4)]=\frac{p(p-1)(3p^3+5p^2-13p+9)}{(p+1)^3(p+3)}=3p-16+\frac{42}{p}+O(p^{-2})\) as \(p\to\infty\).

integrity.exact_rational_checks: verify.py checks tuple-pattern sums for p=2..12 and rational simplification for p=2..40

scientific_limitations: The formula applies only to the uniform correlation-matrix law (LKJ shape eta=1), not to general LKJ shape parameters.
The result is an exact expectation, not a variance, concentration theorem, or fluctuation law.
title: Fourth Spectral Moment of the Uniform Correlation-Matrix Prior
